about: Keys of objects that live for one call and are never stored: an argument object built at the call and read in the callee. Renamed by exact text replacement (not by a tool: rename-members refuses an object key), proved by .scratch/tokens-diff.mjs (identifiers only) and the harness. Keys of the encounter's state, of an actor, of a snapshot or of an event are data: the determinism digest covers them and they keep their names.

didMeleeThisTick: the value handed over is bossState?.didPlanMelee === true: Yama queued the melee in this post-tick and launches it in his next turn

activePhases: the key of the argument of resolveFireballHazards; its value is the list of fireballs in the air, looped over as fireball
shape: the key of the query handed to getActiveFireballs and recordStartPositions; its value is createBurstShapeLookup(...), a function from a burst index to a shape, which getScheduledFireballs stores as shapeForBurst
